rubrics.justification: The response overcalls expansion and blastocoel visibility; the image shows a poorly expanded/possibly early blastocyst with a dense cell mass and limited clear cavity, so assigning 3BB/4BB and describing a large distinct blastocoel is not well supported.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness reasonably well with embryo prognosis, though some links are somewhat overstated.
The structure is logical overall, but the implantation estimate is built on an optimistic morphology assessment and includes some speculative adjustments, reducing internal robustness.

Much is broadly consistent with IVF practice, but suggestions such as routine aspirin/steroids for endometriosis and recommending PGT-A after one failed transfer at age 31 are not strongly guideline-based.
Provides practical next-step recommendations for transfer, luteal support discussion, lifestyle advice, and future planning, though some recommendations lack nuance regarding evidence strength.
